key_grammar.source_sentence: Every salmon river has its own unique set of challenges to which fish must adapt.

explanation.text: 관계절 안의 'fish must adapt to (the challenges)'에서 to가 관계대명사 which 앞으로 통째로 옮겨간 형태예요.
동사 adapt는 전치사 to와 짝을 이루므로(adapt to ~), 그 to가 관계사와 함께 앞으로 나옵니다.
선행사(challenges)가 관계절 안에서 전치사의 목적어이면 '전치사+관계대명사' 형태가 됩니다.
to which fish must adapt = which fish must adapt to = that fish must adapt to (구어).
전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없어요. 'to that'은 틀립니다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: adapt to의 전치사 to가 관계대명사 which 앞으로 이동해 challenges를 수식한다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: And [[1|because]] salmon, [[2|unlike]] cattle and sheep, [[3|can produce]] many thousands of offspring in the course of their lives, once favorable individuals [[4|was found]], just a few strong males and females [[5|could form]] the basis of a whole new race of highly productive fish.
drills.fix: 주어 favorable individuals가 복수이므로 was found → were found(원문)로 고쳐야 한다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: Every salmon river [[has/have]] its own unique set of challenges [[to which/to that]] fish must adapt.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: Others are very far north, with only a short season of warmer temperatures, and require a fish that can maximizes growth, particularly during its younger phase.
drills.fix: 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 maximizes → maximize(원문)로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① The initial selection of farmed Atlantic salmon took place from fish drawn from forty different river systems.
② Some rivers are very long, like the Yukon, and require animals that can build up massive fat reserves in order to survive the extended journey.
③ Others are very far north, with only a short season of warmer temperatures, and require a fish that can maximizes growth, particularly during its younger phase.

④ And because salmon, unlike cattle and sheep, can produce many thousands of offspring in the course of their lives, once favorable individuals were found, just a few strong males and females could form the basis of a whole new race of highly productive fish.
⑤ A domestic population could be created quickly that would be quite different from the initial wild ancestors.

drills.question: 모든 생태계는 생물들이 적응해야 하는 자기만의 고유한 조건을 가지고 있다.
drills.answer: Every ecosystem has its own unique conditions to which organisms must adapt.

drills.question: 모든 연어 강은 물고기가 적응해야 하는 자기만의 고유한 도전 과제를 지니고 있다.
drills.answer: Every salmon river has its own unique set of challenges to which fish must adapt.

restatement_chains.label: 원래 40개 강

sentences.english: Every salmon river has its own unique set of challenges to which fish must adapt.

[[to which fish must adapt.]]

misreads.statement: 모든 연어 강은 물고기가 적응할 필요가 없는, 서로 공통된 도전 과제를 지닌다.
misreads.anchor: its own unique set of challenges to which fish must adapt
misreads.why: 각 강은 고유한 과제를 지니며 물고기는 거기에 적응해야 한다.

mistips: to which = 관계사 앞으로 나온 전치사(adapt to → to which); '적응해야 할 과제'로 해석.
